tools.name: check_report
tools.description: Compute monthly counts and costs from inline CSV rows. Return source records, exact row shares, source hashes, monthly tasks and all unresolved issues. Duplicate row IDs are excluded. People counts require anonymous person IDs. No text is written by AI and no file is stored. Free: one award and 100

tools.name: build_pack
tools.description: Return a base64 ZIP with a draft PDF, editable DOCX, monthly checklist, evidence index, source archive, number ledger and unresolved issues. Text slots stay blank for owner review. All numbers are recomputed from inline CSV rows. Files are not stored. The ZIP is limited to 16 MB.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Return subscription access, the price and current file limits. Nothing is bought through this tool.
